arxiv-2309-12516.description: Abstract Parametric gates and processes engineered from the perspective of the static effective Hamiltonian of a driven system are central to quantum technology. arxiv-2505-05468.creator: Zane M. Rossi
arxiv-2505-05468.description: Abstract Quantum signal processing (QSP) studies quantum circuits interleaving known unitaries (the phases) and unknown unitaries encoding a hidden scalar (the signal).
